thread:
maria: Customer acme-corp (prod) hit 401s right after they ran our CLI key-regen job at 03:10 UTC. CLI returned success but their app started failing.
sam: Which endpoint and what auth header are they sending? Any request ID?
maria: They send Authorization: Bearer <apikey>. Here's the repro they ran:
```bash
redwood-cli keys regen --tenant acme-corp --service web-frontend --confirm
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEW_KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Response: 401 Unauthorized. No vault errors in CLI output.
support-sre: Did they pass --tenant? If the CLI created a key under a different tenant namespace the service token will be invalid for the app's scope.
jordan: Also check the sidecar/env mount path — our older sidecars read REDWOOD_API_KEY from /etc/secrets/key while CLI writes to /var/run/redwood/key by default in some deploys. That mismatch would leave the app using the old key.
anya: Can you paste the Vault audit entry or KMS alias used? If the key was created with wrong alias or policy it won't be accepted.
maria: Pasting minimal vault audit snippet (ids redacted):
```
method=write path=secret/data/acme-corp/keys/web-frontend action=create
auth.identity: tenant=acme-corp service=cli tool=redwood-cli
```
ops-bot: Created ticket SUP-2026: https://redwood.co/support/SUP-2026 — flagged P1, customer down.
sam: Quick repro I ran locally: when tenant flag omitted CLI happily writes to default/namespace and returns 0. We should validate tenant binding server-side.
support-sre: Workaround: restart sidecar/agent so it re-reads mounted key file, or temporarily add old key as fallback header X-Redwood-Alt-Key until we rotate correctly.
maria: Asked customer to restart sidecar and provide logs at /var/log/redwood/agent.log. They've uploaded logs to ticket.
jordan: I'm going to open an infra issue: likely fix is to make CLI fail with non-zero if tenant/service metadata mismatch detected and emit explicit warning.
anya: Also adding server-side validation on key creation: reject creations that don't include tenant-scoped label when account is multi-tenant.
maria: Escalating to eng-infra, attaching customer logs. Ticket updated. @eng-infra please triage.
incident-bot: eng-infra assigned @jordan, ETA 2h.
jordan: Patch merged to make CLI validate tenant flag; rolling to prod now.
maria: Customer confirmed recovery at 04:05 UTC after restart and rekey with --tenant. Closing SUP-2026.
maria: Will follow up with postmortem and a docs note about CLI tenant binding.
